title: Proof system description size bound
statement: Let $d>0$ and let $L$ be a finite system of homogeneous quadratic equations in $d$ variables over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The description size of its associated proof system is at most $5\cdot 2^{3(d+1)^2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite homogeneous quadratic system over $\mathbb{F}_2$
